# Sorceress Rakaria Dran

*Page PDF 12*

THE CORSAIRS OF CAPTAIN FL ARIEL 

## **Rakaria Dran — Dark Elf Sorceress**
## **Sorceress Rakaria Dran**
The Dark Convent are the sisterhood of Druchii sorceresses, ruled over by Morathi from her city of Ghrond. The society is rife with intrigue and power struggles, encouraged by the Hag Queen, who prefers her acolytes to fight amongst themselves to prove their ambition and mettle. After several hundred years, Rakaria Dran grew weary of the constant murderous rivalries amongst her ‘sisters’. She chose to escape Ghrond for a time, joining the _Raptor’s Talon_ under the patronage of Duriath Helbane. 

Rakaria is a dark-haired Elf of striking, albeit harsh, appearance. She wears the elaborate headpiece and attire of a Sorceress to remind the crew of her station. She chooses to remain aloof and exchanges little more than words of command with any Elf other than Flariel, Beastmaster Corvian, and her servant Khana. 

Life away from Ghrond suits Rakaria, though the Dark Convent’s reach is long and she knows she must return some day. She plans to return with relics from Elven colonies from before the Sundering, ideally items of significance to the Witch King himself. To this end, she seeks the sunken city of Athel Toralien, Malekith’s former capital that was destroyed by the Dwarfs during the War of the Beard. 

Rakaria offers support to Flariel in public, reassuring his crew that they all have much to gain if only they pull together and cooperate. However, she is privately riven with feelings of mistrust. Each of them assumes the other plots against them — which is basically true. She fears the intrigues of Ghrond will pursue her, and believes (wrongly) that Corvian works on behalf of another sorceress to take anything she discovers in the Old World and leave her dead.

## A Deal with a Druchii
Claud Borgis of Ferlangen is a pedlar who travels between towns in Ostland and the northern Empire. He pays excellent prices for Elven relics, providing they are genuine (he has a sharp eye) and the seller describes where they acquired it, in strict confidence. Claud recently came to the attention of Naradryn Frostweald, an Eonir dealer in Elven artefacts, who suspects there is something behind the pedlar’s newfound wealth and enthusiasm for relics. Frostweald is correct — Borgis met with Rakaria Dran on a windswept shore two years ago. She spared his life on the understanding that he finds artefacts for the sorceress in exchange for plentiful gold.
